items.name: text-shimmer
items.title: Text Shimmer
items.description: A light sweep that moves across text. CSS only — no dependencies.

items.name: marquee
items.title: Marquee
items.description: An infinite horizontal scroller with a seamless loop. CSS only — no dependencies.

items.name: split-text
items.title: Split Text
items.description: Characters or words stagger into view when scrolled to. Powered by Motion.

items.name: venom
items.title: Venom
items.description: A living symbiote covers your text or SVG, crawls over it and sends writhing tendrils after the pointer. WebGL 2, no dependencies.

items.name: spotlight-card
items.title: Spotlight Card
items.description: A card with a radial glow that follows the pointer. Powered by Motion.

items.name: gradient-carousel
items.title: Gradient Carousel
items.description: A looping 3D card carousel you turn by wheel, drag or arrow keys, over a blurred gradient drawn in the colours of the centre image. No dependencies.

items.name: scroll-reveal
items.title: Scroll Reveal
items.description: Fades and slides its children in when they enter the viewport. Powered by Motion.

items.name: scroll-portal
items.title: Scroll Portal
items.description: Scroll flies the camera through nested frames, each opening onto the next scene. No dependencies.

items.name: tile-reveal
items.title: Tile Reveal
items.description: A pinned image grid whose tiles fly in column by column on scroll, then zoom past the edges to reveal a headline and call to action. No dependencies.

items.name: scroll-mask
items.title: Scroll Mask
items.description: Scroll opens a mask that reveals an image six ways: iris, wipe, curtain, slats, grid or a word. No dependencies.

items.name: text-scroll-highlight
items.title: Text Scroll Highlight
items.description: Text whose words light up one by one with the scroll, either as it moves up the screen or pinned in place like a subtitle. No dependencies.

items.name: aurora-background
items.title: Aurora Background
items.description: A slowly drifting gradient backdrop with a fade-in for its content. A WebGL 2 shader, with a static CSS gradient wherever WebGL is unavailable.

items.name: pattern-waves
items.title: Pattern Waves
items.description: A lit field of dots, squares, lines or glyphs rolling over silk, swell or ripple waves, with a cursor ripple. WebGL 2 through ogl.

items.name: grainient
items.title: Grainient
items.description: A flowing, film-grained gradient in up to eight colours that stirs under the pointer and swirls on click. Raw WebGL 2, no dependencies.

items.name: dot-grid
items.title: Dot Grid
items.description: A grid of dots on springs: they scatter from the pointer, ripple out from a click and settle back. Raw WebGL 2, no dependencies.

items.name: hero-aurora
items.title: Hero — Aurora
items.description: A hero section: aurora backdrop, word-by-word headline, description and two call-to-action buttons.

items.name: features-spotlight
items.title: Features — Spotlight
items.description: A features section: shimmering eyebrow, heading, a scroll-revealed grid of spotlight cards and a logo marquee.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Drop-in replacement for shadcn's tabs. Adds an indicator that slides between tabs instead of jumping. Same exports, same props.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: Drop-in replacement for shadcn's collapsible, which ships with no animation at all. Adds eased height and a content fade. Same exports, same props.

items.name: album-rail
items.title: Album Rail
items.description: A fanned rail of album sleeves that turn away in 3D, with a record that slides out and spins on play, a tick ruler, swipe, wheel and arrow keys. No dependencies.

items.name: picture-credit
items.title: Picture Credit
items.description: A picture's credit, centred: its name underlined and linked, then place and date, over a small grey line. No dependencies.

items.name: picture-figure
items.title: Picture Figure
items.description: A picture at its proportions, its height set by the page, with a caption hanging under it that takes no room. No dependencies.

items.name: rich-text
items.title: Rich Text
items.description: A paragraph of copy with *italic* and [linked words] markup; links open in a new tab with a small arrow. No dependencies.

items.name: scroll-stage
items.title: Scroll Stage
items.description: A fixed stage whose pieces move, scale and fade by scroll position, replaying measured keyframe tracks per layout, with time-based fades and a text entrance. Needs gsap and @gsap/react.

items.name: word-cycle
items.title: Word Cycle
items.description: One word at a time inside a line of text, each fading and rising into place in the width of the longest word. No dependencies.

items.name: corner-hint
items.title: Corner Hint
items.description: A glass hint in the bottom corner that grows in as it fades in, with a message that can replace it for a moment; announced politely to screen readers. No dependencies.

items.name: intro-wordmark
items.title: Intro Wordmark
items.description: A story's name as the page loads: it fades in mid-screen, then moves up to the top centre, difference-blended over the pictures. Hides on wide screens once the reader scrolls away. No dependencies.

items.name: corner-wordmark
items.title: Corner Wordmark
items.description: The name in the top corner, linking back to the start: it fades in once the reader scrolls away, difference-blended over the pictures. No dependencies.

items.name: zoom-panel
items.title: Zoom Panel
items.description: A document thumbnail in the corner that opens into a large panel zoomed into one highlighted band of the picture. No dependencies.

items.name: chapter-nav
items.title: Chapter Nav
items.description: Chapter navigation for a long scroll story: a glass rail of dots at the inline end, the current chapter's dot stretched and filling as you read, that opens a panel listing the chapters with a progress bar under each. Controlled or on its own. No dependencies.

items.name: glass-panel
items.title: Glass Panel
items.description: A glass panel that grows out of the button that opens it, its content dropping into place in turn. Parts like shadcn's dialog (GlassPanel, GlassPanelTrigger, GlassPanelContent, GlassPanelTitle, GlassPanelFooter, GlassPanelClose) on a non-modal Base UI dialog: Escape and a press outside close it, focus moves in and back.

items.name: scroll-captions
items.title: Scroll Captions
items.description: Captions that take turns in one place as the reader scrolls, on a pinned stage: the old one fades out quickly, the new one fades in while slowly growing. Pins to its scroll container or the page. No dependencies.

items.name: rising-captions
items.title: Rising Captions
items.description: Captions that rise one after another through a pinned stage as you scroll, slower than the page: each fades in low, climbs steadily and fades out before the top. No dependencies.

items.name: zoom-picture
items.title: Zoom Picture
items.description: A picture that pins as you scroll, zooms in until it fills the view, pans down through itself and zooms back out, its dark scrim deepening as it grows so white text over it reads; a scroll stage can drive it instead through --s. No dependencies.

items.name: date-timeline
items.title: Date Timeline
items.description: A short line with a gap that slides to the current date, and the dates; a scroll stage moves it through its tracks. No dependencies.

items.name: picture-cloud
items.title: Picture Cloud
items.description: Thousands of small picture tiles that form a ring of petals, gather into a pile and grow into a turning, ghosting ball as their progress is driven, drawn in one call and idle when still. Raw WebGL 2, no dependencies.

items.name: picture-wave
items.title: Picture Wave
items.description: Picture cards fly in as a wave between two words, hold, then burst into a floating field that leans away from the pointer, drawn in one call and idle when still. Raw WebGL 2, no dependencies.

items.name: picture-orbit
items.title: Picture Orbit
items.description: Picture cards that rise past a still title as you scroll, each along an oval around it, on three depth layers that drift and lean away from the pointer, drawn in one call and idle when still. Raw WebGL 2, no dependencies.

items.name: picture-trail
items.title: Picture Trail
items.description: A picture's trail through time on a pinned stage: a huge name crosses the view, its holders pass beside it in turn, and a second name follows and stays faded behind it. No dependencies.

items.name: names-duel
items.title: Names — Duel
items.description: Two huge names and the pictures between them, played by scroll on a pinned stage: the first rests at the top and shrinks away as the second grows into its place. Pins to its scroll container or the page.

items.name: portrait-pair
items.title: Portraits — Pair
items.description: Two portraits played by scroll on a pinned stage: the second rises inside the first while small pictures fan out around them, then the portraits move apart side by side under a closing paragraph. Pins to its scroll container or the page.
